name: Exposure Calculation
definition: Description of the calculation of the amounts representing the risk that needs to be covered, together with the calculation of the existing coverage.

TotalCollateralCurrentValue.name: Total Collateral Current Value
TotalCollateralCurrentValue.definition: Total value of the collateral derived from the sum of the current independent amounts and variation margins held, agreed and in transit.

TotalExposedAmount.name: Total Exposed Amount
TotalExposedAmount.definition: The sum of the exposures of all transactions which are in favour of a Party. That is, all transactions which would have an amount payable by the counterparty if they were being terminated.

TotalCollateralAfterHaircut.name: Total Collateral After Haircut
TotalCollateralAfterHaircut.definition: Collateral currently received (+)/delivered (-) in the base currency. This amount is after the haircut has been applied.

CurrentIndependentAmount.name: Current Independent Amount
CurrentIndependentAmount.definition: Amount applied as an add-on to the exposure usually intended to cover a possible increase in exposure before the next valuation date.

CurrentVariationMargin.name: Current Variation Margin
CurrentVariationMargin.definition: Provides details about the collateral held, in transit or that still needs to be agreed by both parties, against the variation margin.

CurrentSegregatedIndependentAmount.name: Current Segregated Independent Amount
CurrentSegregatedIndependentAmount.definition: Provides details about the collateral held, in transit or that still needs to be agreed by both parties, against the segregated independent amount only.

VariationMarginAmountRequirement.name: Variation Margin Amount Requirement
VariationMarginAmountRequirement.definition: Amount of expected margin required by any of the parties of the margin calculation.

SegregatedAmountRequirement.name: Segregated Amount Requirement
SegregatedAmountRequirement.definition: Margin requirements for the segregated independent amount.

CollateralManagement.name: Collateral Management
CollateralManagement.definition: Specifies the collateral management actions resulting from the calculation of the risk.

CounterpartyRisk.name: Counterparty Risk
CounterpartyRisk.definition: Calculation of the exposure amount that one party has vis-a-vis one counterparty or a central system, based on its credit risk.

TransactionRisk.name: Transaction Risk
TransactionRisk.definition: Calculation of the exposure amount that one party has vis-a-vis one counterparty or a central system, based on the transactions that are not yet settled.
